id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying schema discovery on a plan gated 400

review.posthog_relevance: Adds dedicated exception handling and credential validation for the Convex Professional plan's streaming export restriction, distinguishing it from generic authentication failures.
review.reason: Adds a dedicated exception class and HTTP 400 parsing to distinguish a specific plan-restriction error, and updates credential validation to recognize this exception. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement for warehouse ingestion and credential handling.
review.uncertainty: The tier cannot reach 3 because the implementation of the exception recognition and the complete set of recognized error keys is not visible in this chunk, and the chunk does not include the actual ConvexSource class implementation. The benefit relies on unverified outcomes regarding the broader system's behavior and the complete implementation of the exception handling.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of get_non_retryable_errors or the actual ConvexSource class, so it cannot demonstrate how the new exception is recognized as a non-retryable error. The tests assert that the error message contains a key, but without seeing the set of recognized keys, the tier cannot be established. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds StreamingExportNotEnabledError exception class and its definition.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a dedicated exception for the Convex Professional plan's streaming export restriction, replacing reliance on HTTP status or generic HTTPError messages.

observations.behavior: Adds HTTP 400 body parsing to detect StreamingExportNotEnabled error code and raises the new exception.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to distinguish the specific plan-restriction error from other 400s, rather than treating it as a generic HTTP error.

observations.behavior: Updates credential validation to catch the new exception and return a specific error message instead of the previous HTTPError handling.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes credential validation behavior to recognize the plan-restriction error and return a user-friendly message rather than a generic authentication failure.
